title: Mapletown Junior/Senior High School
overview: A field study found multiple building systems failing and inefficient. Using whole-building computer modeling, MEI planned a two-phase HVAC renovation within the district's budget and schedule; Phase 1's success and energy savings led the owner to add a cooling upgrade in Phase 2. Administration reported improved classroom conditions, air quality, and test scores — with $50,000 in first-year energy savings.
